title: TurnRecord
description: One settled turn of a session transcript.

error_type.description:
Content-free classification of a failed or interrupted turn, such as
`cancelled` or `RunLimit(ToolCalls)`; `None` for a completed turn.

finished_at.description:
When the turn settled, to the second for SQLite sessions; on the
wire, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

input.description: The turn's input blocks in order.

instructions.description: Host instructions given for this turn only.

items.description:
What the model produced, in order: reasoning, assistant text, tool
calls with their results, and, for a completed turn, the final
output last.

started_at.description:
When the turn was admitted, to the second for SQLite sessions; on the
wire, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

turn.description: Durable position of the turn within its session.

usage.description:
Tokens of the turn's model requests, when recorded: only turns run
with a host request ID keep their usage.

TranscriptInput.description: One input block of a transcript turn.

data.description: Standard base64 encoding of the image bytes.

TranscriptItem.description:
One item a transcript turn produced.

It mirrors [`crate::event::Item`], except that a tool call carries only
what the session stores: its result text, without the status and summary
a live run reports.

oneOf.description: Assistant text the model wrote beside its tool calls.
The validated final output of a completed turn.
Provider reasoning returned with a model response.
A tool call and, when one was recorded, its result.

RunOutput.description:
Validated final output of a successful run.

It serializes as `{"type": "json" | "text", "value": ...}`.

oneOf.description: JSON output validated against the run's output schema.
The final assistant text of a run in text output mode.

TranscriptToolCall.description: A tool call of a transcript turn.

arguments.description: Arguments as the model sent them, as JSON text.

result.description:
Result text the model received, or `None` when the turn stopped
before the call was answered.

oneOf.description: The turn committed its final output.
The turn failed, for example on a model error or a run limit.
The turn was cancelled or its owner stopped renewing it.

TurnIndex.description: Durable position of a turn within its session.

Usage.description:
Provider-reported tokens, summed over a run's model requests.

The counts overlap: `cache_read` is part of `input`, and `reasoning` is
part of `output`. A count a provider omitted adds zero; a request whose
provider reported no input or output count is counted in
`unreported_requests`, so totals with unreported requests are lower
bounds. Requests the provider rejected as exceeding its context window,
and a request in flight when the run was cancelled, are not counted.

cache_read.description: Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache.

cache_write.description:
Input tokens written to the provider's prompt cache, or `None` when
unknown; no supported provider reports them yet.

unreported_requests.description: Model requests whose provider reported no input or output count.
